component.name: LiveTVGuideStaticEffect
component.script:
sub init() m.staticLayer1 = m.top.findNode("staticLayer1") m.staticLayer2 = m.top.findNode("staticLayer2") m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") m.noiseViewport = m.top.findNode("noiseViewport") m.scanlines = m.top.findNode("scanlines") m.noiseTimer = m.top.findNode("noiseTimer") m.noiseFrame = 0 m.scanlinePool = []
m.top.observeField("width", "onSizeChanged") m.top.observeField("height", "onSizeChanged") m.top.observeField("visible", "onVisibilityChanged") m.noiseTimer.observeField("fire", "onNoiseTick")
buildScanlines() onSizeChanged() onVisibilityChanged() end sub
sub buildScanlines() for index = 0 to 63 line = createObject("roSGNode", "Rectangle") line.height = 1 line.color = "0x020304FF" m.scanlines.appendChild(line) m.scanlinePool.push(line) end for end sub
sub onSizeChanged() w = m.top.width h = m.top.height
if w <= 0 then w = 512 if h <= 0 then h = 512
m.bg.width = w m.bg.height = h m.noiseViewport.clippingRect = [0, 0, w, h] m.staticLayer1.width = w + 96 m.staticLayer2.width = w + 96 m.staticLayer1.height = h + 96 m.staticLayer2.height = h + 96
for index = 0 to m.scanlinePool.count() - 1 line = m.scanlinePool[index] line.width = w line.translation = [0, int((index * h) / m.scanlinePool.count())] end for renderNoiseFrame() end sub
sub onVisibilityChanged() if m.top.visible renderNoiseFrame() m.noiseTimer.control = "start" else m.noiseTimer.control = "stop" end if end sub
sub onNoiseTick() m.noiseFrame = (m.noiseFrame + 1) mod 997 renderNoiseFrame() end sub
sub renderNoiseFrame() frame = m.noiseFrame m.staticLayer1.translation = [-48 + ((frame * 37) mod 96), -48 + ((frame * 53) mod 96)] m.staticLayer2.translation = [-48 + ((frame * 71) mod 96), -48 + ((frame * 29) mod 96)] m.staticLayer1.opacity = 0.50 + (((frame * 17) mod 18) / 100.0) m.staticLayer2.opacity = 0.28 + (((frame * 31) mod 20) / 100.0)
for index = 0 to m.scanlinePool.count() - 1 line = m.scanlinePool[index] line.opacity = 0.03 + ((((frame + index) * 19) mod 15) / 100.0) end for end sub
